text:
emily_cs: Heads up — Peregrine Claims signed an intake form asking for a custom NER for claims processing. They called out PHI extraction (names, SSNs, policy_numbers, ICD codes) and strict data residency. Renewal in ~5 weeks so they'd like a safety + deployment plan this sprint. Can ENG + SAFETY + SRE advise? :wave:

raj_eng: Quick clarifying Q — do they have span labels or document-level tags? format? if spans (CoNLL/JSONL) we can run our eval harness fast. For model suggestion: start with 7B-quant on Dedicated; fallback to 13B if recall or PHI leakage is unacceptable.

emily_cs: They have ~5k span-labeled docs in JSONL. Typical sequence length ~200 tokens, peak expected 1-4 qps, mostly daytime bursts. Security note: keys must be customer-managed; they asked whether HSM is supported for Private. Contacts: am@peregrine.com (Marta), infra@peregrine.com (Diego).

noah_safety: Please confirm their PHI definition (SSNs are high risk). We'll request 100 unredacted/redacted pairs for a focused leakage check. Proposed acceptance gates: label-level F1 >= 0.88 for core PHI labels and phi_leak_rate < 1% on the validation slice. Also want requirement docs for retention and post-processing.

olga_enable: I'll run enablement with a 45m walkthrough + handoff doc + quickstart notebook. Recommend ML engineer + security engineer attend. I'll prepare a template checklist for production monitoring.

tina_sre: Sizing Qs: p95 latency target? if they accept p95 ~600ms, 7B-quant on Dedicated with dynamic batching should be fine for 1-4 qps with a single A100 and autoscale buffer. Private + HSM will affect throughput — need Diego's infra spec.

raj_eng: Ask Peregrine to drop a 150-200 sample (mixed) into their secure bucket and share path. I'll run a paired evaluation: 7b-quant vs 13b-fp16 on that sample and report entity F1 + phi_leak_rate. Example eval command we can run internally:

```
redwood eval run --model redwood/7b-q --dataset s3://peregrine-onboard/samples/ner_150.jsonl \
  --metrics entity_f1,phi_leak_rate --output s3://redwood-cs-results/peregrine/7b-run
```

noah_safety: Also schedule adversarial prompt tests: prompts that try to elicit confidential tokens. We'll add sanitization fallback: if model emits high-confidence PHI tokens, route result through redaction microservice.

emily_cs: Sample path shared: s3://peregrine-onboard/secure/ner_150_sample.jsonl (access granted to our VPC). Created Jira CS-7100 and added to the customer renewal watchlist. Marta + Diego cc'd. Can we sync Wed 11AM PT for a quick alignment?

olga_enable: Wed 11AM PT works. I'll send calendar invite and include a short agenda: dataset walk, eval plan, monitoring + rollback playbook.

tina_sre: Tentatively holding Dedicated slot for the week of the sync. If Peregrine confirms dedicated commit we will finalize capacity and pricing. Diego — please send GPU inventory if they want Private.

raj_eng: I'll kick off the AB evals once the sample is reachable inside our VPC. Plan: run both models, produce per-label F1 and a PHI leak report, then summarize differences and recommend path. Expect results in 48-72h.

noah_safety: I'll add pass/fail criteria into CS-7100 and request a 25-record manual review for edge cases. Also add monitoring hooks: Console alert if any output matches SSN regex or contains unredacted policy numbers.

deploy-bot: Jira CS-7100 created: "Peregrine Claims - claims NER onboarding & PHI safeguards" 4dd https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-7100

emily_cs: Thanks team — next steps listed in CS-7100: ENG run AB evals, SAFETY prepare redaction + adversarial tests, SRE confirm tentative capacity, ENABLE run workshop and handoff. Marking this high on renewal-risk tracker. :lock:
